title: Thea Green, Founder of Nails Inc., Exits Company Following Sale to Pacific World Corp.
summary: Green, who sold her nail salon and products company two years ago, said "the customer has always been my number-one obsession — without them, nothing is possible."

extraction.key_fact: 네일스 인크 창업자 테아 그린이 회사 매각 후 회사를 떠났다.
